scientific_integrity: Complete finite simplicial collapse, integral Smith normal form, signed symmetry, primitive cocycle pairing were independently reconstructed from bundled instructions; finite exact proof and self-review only, no independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the 24-vertex graph metric at inclusive radius two to three. Integral equivariant splitting, higher-label cases, and other radii are not established. Search cannot rule out unindexed equivalent findings.
title: Integral equivariant persistence of the four-label permutahedron
